results.title: Comelec targets 4 million new voters for 2028 elections
results.content: MANILA, Philippines — The Commission on Elections (Comelec) expects four million new voter registrants for the 2028 elections, exceeding its earlier target. Comelec Chair George Erwin Garcia made the estimate on Sunday, following the resumption of voter registration on Nov. 10. The poll body will accept applications until July 30, 2027. results.title: Comelec reminds public: No fees for voter certifications
results.content: MANILA, Philippines – The Commission on Elections (Comelec) on Thursday reminded the public that voter certifications are issued free of charge nationwide amid reports of social media posts falsely claiming that applicants were being charged for the document. Comelec Chair George Erwin Garcia said the certification is free regardless of the number of copies requested
